settings.heading: It started with a shelf of empty promises.
settings.content: No silicone. No synthetic fragrance. Just a clean, dry-touch firming oil and a stubborn belief that one good minute a day beats a ten-step routine.

settings.title: Tacky, perfumed, fake
settings.text: Camille tried every firming cream on the shelf. They were either sticky, heavily perfumed, or made of promises and silicone — nothing she actually wanted to use daily.

settings.title: Caffeine, not claims
settings.text: We formulated the opposite: weightless squalane and jojoba carrying caffeine-rich green coffee and guarana, with no synthetic fragrance and a texture that disappears.

settings.title: The one-minute test
settings.text: Real women used 4–6 drops, once a day, for eight weeks. Skin looked smoother and firmer — and they kept reaching for the bottle.

settings.title: 6,400+ firmer mornings
settings.text: One bottle. One minute. The same clean, dry-touch oil — now part of thousands of daily rituals.
We'll never use silicones to fake a smooth finish.
We'll never make a medical claim our formula can't back up.
